1.67 hem GIRIS HATALARINI duzeltir hem hesap guvenligini sikilastirir. Yeni izin, yeni veri toplama, yeni satin alma YOKTUR.
1) Acilistaki \Kimlik dogrulaniyor\ ekrani, sunucu dogrulamasi yanit vermezse sonsuza kadar kalabiliyordu; \Yeniden dene\ yalniz cevrimdisi durumunda vardi ve arka plandan donus kontrolu yeniden calistirmiyordu (scenePhase yalnizca oturum acikken dinleniyordu). Kullanici ancak uygulamayi komple kapatarak kurtulabiliyordu. 20 saniyelik bekci + on plana donuste yeniden dogrulama eklendi.
2) App Attest, ortak istek katmani uzerinden 401 alinca kullaniciyi sessizce oturumdan dusurebiliyordu; artik oturumu kapatmayan ayri bir istek yolu kullaniyor.
3) Giris baslatilamadiginda gercek sebep gosteriliyor.
4) Google giris istemcisi ayni gelistirici hesabina ait baska bir Google Cloud projesine tasindi; Apple girisi ve iOS client kimligi degismedi, mevcut oturumlar etkilenmedi.
5) YENI: hesap tek cihaza baglanir. Baska cihazda giris yapilinca onceki cihazin oturumu duser. Cihaz kimligi identifierForVendor'dur; reklam kimligi degildir, yeni izin gerektirmez, ucuncu taraflarla paylasilmaz. Kimse kilitlenmez, istedigi cihazda tekrar giris yapabilir.
asc_inceleme_notu_en:
Move Log turns recorded GPS rides (motorcycle, bicycle, walking, running) into cinematic satellite route videos.

WHAT CHANGED IN 1.67
This release fixes sign-in problems reported by users and hardens account security. No new permissions, no new data collection, no new purchases.

1) LAUNCH SCREEN COULD HANG. The app validates the stored session against our server at launch ("Verifying identity"). If that request never returned, the screen stayed there forever: the retry button only existed in the offline state, and returning from the background did not re-run the check because the scene-phase observer lived inside the authenticated view. Users could only escape by force-quitting. Fixed two ways: a 20-second watchdog moves the app to the retry screen, and the app now re-validates whenever it returns to the foreground while not signed in.

2) APP ATTEST COULD SIGN THE USER OUT SILENTLY. App Attest is fail-open by design, but it used the shared request helper, which signs the user out on any HTTP 401. It now uses a separate request path that never ends the session.

3) SIGN-IN ERRORS ARE EXPLAINED. When sign-in cannot start, the app shows the actual reason instead of a generic "try again".

4) GOOGLE SIGN-IN CLIENT MOVED. The Google OAuth client was moved to another Google Cloud project owned by the same developer account. The Apple sign-in flow and the iOS Google client ID are unchanged; existing sessions are unaffected. No user-visible change.

5) ONE ACTIVE DEVICE PER ACCOUNT (new). An account is now bound to the device it signs in from. Signing in on a different device ends the session on the previous device, which then returns to the sign-in screen. This is standard single-session behaviour and prevents account sharing. The device identifier is Apple's identifierForVendor - no advertising identifier, no new permission, and it is never shared with third parties. Nothing is blocked: the user can always sign in again on any device.

Existing accounts, purchases and subscriptions are unaffected.
